title: Wings
author: Tirna Sarkar
text:
I used to dance , I used to sing .
Now I can hardly stretch my wings.
They pierced my wings and blamed me for not being tough enough.
They plucked my feathers one by one and showed it to people
While I bled , hurt , and hollowed out with every plucking of the feather .
I saw him standing by with a bowl as he collected my feathers and put them on display on the mantelpiece.
My wings are of new use now.
I can`t fly, I can only flap them and then sit in one place.
I look overhead and see my peers fly. They wave to me asking me to join.
Yet I sit there still and unmoving .
My wings feel like a burden now since I have to drag them everywhere.
But I can`t fly. The sky beckons me , and my tears fall in an incessant stream.
Yet I can`t fly.

Seems like a death with the heart still beating.
